billboard.placement: empty square connected to the road used to reach the tile
billboard.reaches: all houses orthogonally adjacent to the tile (a house counts if only its garden is adjacent)

mailbox.placement: empty square adjacent to a road
mailbox.reaches: all houses in the same block (reachable without crossing a road; passes through restaurants/houses)

airplane.placement: on the side of the board; not road-connected; not affected by range; must fly over exactly its size in rows/columns and stay on the board
airplane.reaches: every house in the fly-over line of 1/3/5 rows or columns (counts if only part of house/garden is in the zone)

radio.placement: empty square adjacent to a road
radio.reaches: every house on the radio's tile plus houses on all 8 surrounding tiles

busyChip.rule: Placed on a marketeer equal to campaign duration; marketeer takes no slot while busy but may still require salary. After each firing remove one advertising token; when zero, free the marketeer.

milestoneInteractions.firstBillboardPlaced: That player's campaigns become eternal (never end); marketeer removed for the game; no marketeer salaries.
milestoneInteractions.firstRadioCampaign: Radio places 2 demand tokens per reached house instead of 1 (0/1 if nearly full).
